p: heathen rage: The conspiracy of the Gentiles, the murmuring of the Jews and power of kings cannot prevail against Christ.
Let us break their bands asunder: Thus the wicked say that they will cast off the yoke of God and of his Christ.
Then shall he speak unto them: God's plagues will declare that in resisting his Christ, they fought against him.
decree: To show that my calling to the kingdom is from God.

day have I begotten thee: That is to say, concerning man's knowledge, because it was the first time that David appeared to be elected by God. So it is applied to Christ in his first coming and manifestation to the world.
uttermost parts of the earth for: Not only the Jews but the Gentiles also.
Be wise now therefore: He exhorts all rulers to repent in time.
Kiss the Son: In a sign of homage.
perish from the way: When the wicked will say, Peace and rest, then will destruction suddenly come, 1Th 5:3.
